section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the findings of the present study, which aimed to translate the GQ-6 for the Italian population. The study replicated previous psychometric properties, confirming a one-factor solution and acceptable Cronbach's alpha. It also confirmed high correlations with life satisfaction, subjective happiness, and social desirability, and a negative correlation with loneliness. The section notes that no gender differences in gratitude were detected and discusses a modest correlation with age in a relatively young Italian sample.
